method: Opened the actual durable original PNG at original resolution. Separately enlarged its right panel by nearest-neighbor to distinguish the unmarked lower-left bend from an atomic dot. Counts and edges below come from those source pixels, not the assignment's verbal ring classes.
coordinateRule: Approximate source-screen centers identify individual printed nodes for mapping only; they are not physical coordinates or calibrated readings.

a.description: Left panel: one regular six-junction ring. Six filled dots occupy its corners; each side has one hollow intermediate dot. Every filled corner also connects outward to one hollow terminal. All edges solid. No numeric data, dimensions, axes, arrows or element legend.

b.description: Right panel: two connected irregular loops sharing the filled b-F1 to filled b-F6 chain through hollow b-O1. Left loop has five filled junctions and six hollow intermediate dots; its lower-right long side contains TWO hollow dots and an unmarked bend. Right loop has seven filled junctions and seven hollow intermediate dots. Nine hollow external terminals remain. All source connections solid; no invented additional six-junction loop.

unmarkedBend.rule: Preserve the two-segment bent edge using literal hidden construction coordinates. Never add a filled or hollow dot at this bend.

sourceSubfigureMarks: a-like printed mark under left panel
languageMapping.basis: Current frozen n49 explicitly localizes the source subfigure marks to Latin a/b.

modernAdditions: Regularize only panel a's uncalibrated printed hexagon to an exact regular hexagon, its hollow side midpoints and outward terminal directions; source counts and adjacency are unchanged.
Panel b uses a single uniform source-screen transform: no rearrangement, new ring, new terminal or new atomic dot.
Crisp semantic-role lines and consistent filled/hollow circles replace print irregularity; no numeric data, bond-angle values, element legend or strong three-dimensional structural claim is added.
contextLimits: The full modern text defines this as a simplified comparison, not measured complete three-dimensional quartz/silica geometry.
Six-junction ring is visibly in a; b's two visible loops have five and seven filled junctions. No extra six-junction loop is inferred from prose wording.
The right-panel unmarked bend is line geometry, not an additional atomic node.
